component.name: Entanglo
component.summary: Share mouse, keyboard, clipboard and files with trusted devices on your LAN

description.p: Entanglo connects Mac, Windows, Android and Linux devices on the same Wi-Fi with a shared mouse and keyboard, clipboard sync, chunked file transfer, and a printer bridge. No cloud service — fully peer-to-peer, LAN-only.
Initial Debian scaffolding — protocol, transport, and app shell.
